description: Create a persisted event, subscriber-attribute, or tag-applied conversion goal for one sequence. Event goals (the default triggerType) require triggerEventName; attribute_change goals require attributePath; tag_added goals require triggerTagName. This is distinct from create_sequence.goal, which is only an AI content prompt.

attributeCondition.description: How the subscriber attribute must change.

attributePath.description: Subscriber attribute path required for attribute_change goals.

attributeValue.description: Target value for changed_to or changed_from_to.

companyId.description: Company ID. If omitted, uses the currently selected company.

eventPropertyLabel.description: Display label for the tracked event property.

eventPropertyName.description: Optional event property whose numeric value is tracked.

isActive.description: Whether conversion tracking is active for this goal. Defaults to true when creating.

triggerEventName.description: Required event name for event goals.

triggerTagName.description: Required tag name for tag_added goals, e.g. customer.

triggerType.description: Conversion signal type. Defaults to event when creating.

name: create_sequence_goal

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `create_sequence_goal` MCP tool.

goal.description: The sequence goal record returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
